title: Pressure at point C
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the normal force (pressure) at point C as 6mg, with correct direction.

title: Condition at highest point
description: Essential: Applies the condition for circular motion at point E to find v_E = sqrt(gR).

title: Work-energy from A to B
description: Important: Correctly applies the work-energy theorem between points A and B, including friction and gravity.

title: Work-energy from B to C
description: Important: Applies the work-energy theorem between points B and C to relate velocities and geometry.

title: Work-energy from C to E
description: Important: Applies the work-energy theorem between points C and E to find v_C.

title: Power of gravity at B
description: Important: Correctly calculates instantaneous power as P = mg * v_B * sin(theta).

title: Friction work result
description: Essential: Correctly deduces that the work done by friction from A to B is zero.

title: Sign error in work-energy
description: Pitfall: Uses incorrect sign for gravitational potential energy change or friction work.

title: Misapplies circular motion condition
description: Pitfall: Applies the condition v=0 or incorrect force balance at the top of the loop (point E).

title: Unit or vector oversight
description: Optional: Explicitly states units for final answers or clarifies vector nature of pressure.
